resolution_caveats.noIndexArm: THE ARM IS INDEX=no AND THAT IS THE HONEST ARM: there is no INDEX_SPECS entry for go in script/m14/incoming-gate.ts, so no production project index is built. TABLE 1's scope is the gate's own PER-PROJECT declaration table, built from every file this whole-population run parsed (50589 admitted, 27 repositories). A reader must not read `resolved` as "the production index bound it".
resolution_caveats.slicesArm: THE ARM IS A UNION OF 51 DISJOINT SLICES, NOT ONE PROCESS: the window reaped whole-population runs, so the population was walked [0, 50589) in slices and merged by script/m14/merge-arm-slices.ts, which REFUSES a hole, an overlap, a slice whose parsed count is not its claimed width, and a closure whose eleven terms do not sum. The path from slice to declaration is: slice logs (TABLE 1 + BINDING INTENT) → merge → closure artifact → this generator, and every identity is re-checked at each step.
resolution_caveats.collResSubset: `collRes` is a SUBSET of `resolved` — a resolved edge whose target has MORE THAN ONE declaration in the project, so production's own-file tie-break chose the row. It is NEVER added to `resolved`. It is 463,112 of the lane's 2,889,098 resolved edges and ALL of it sits on `contains` (a Go package's scope declares a name in every file that spells it: a `div`-class name). The fleet's indexer measures 37,318 of 49,729 such picks as WRONG, so the resolved column is a FLOOR on correctness, not a count of correct edges.
resolution_caveats.ambKindSubset: `amb(kind)` (694,031) is a SUBSET of `amb(decl)` (1,199,366): distinct KINDS among colliding declarations vs distinct DECLARATIONS. It is reported beside and never added, and only the by-declaration count is in the closure.
resolution_caveats.embeddingSplit: GO'S EMBEDDING IS SPLIT BY THE CONTRACT AND BOTH HALVES ARE COUNTED: struct embedding is `mixes_in` (13477 rows, all resolved — the struct composes the embedded type's IMPLEMENTATION with no declared supertype), interface embedding is `extends` (2683 rows, all resolved — method-set inclusion with no implementation composed). The struct half is a 1:1 RELABEL of the rows the lane previously published as extends (same source/target/line/confidence 0.8; metadata.relationshipType is still go_struct_embedding). The delta versus the CONSTRUCT census is reconciled below, not rounded.
resolution_caveats.rendersConstruct: `renders` (11 rows) IS THE TEMPLATE-EXECUTION RENDER HOST: source = the symbol whose body executes an `html/template`, target = a PUBLISHED package-level template symbol. It is gated on the html/template IMPORT and the constructor qualifier is resolved to that import's own local name, so `text/template` (144 importing files, the measured impostor class, almost all generators) cannot produce a row; locals, parameters, fields, call results, expression receivers and name strings are excluded BY CONSTRUCTION. The `calls` row for the same Execute invocation is a DIFFERENT and also-true fact — renders is ADDITIVE, not a relabel of calls.
resolution_caveats.constructReconciliation: CONSTRUCT-SITE vs ROW RECONCILIATION (whole population, this lane's census): mixes_in: 13477 construct sites − 0 sites whose embedded type has no nameable leaf = 13477 rows, EXACTLY. mixes_in disclosure: the 14387 whole-population embedding sites are 13477 inside a NAMED type declaration (row-capable) + 910 inside an ANONYMOUS struct type (no declared source, cannot be a row). extends: 2683 construct sites − 0 = 2683 rows, EXACTLY. extends disclosure: the 2869 whole-population embedding sites are 2683 row-capable (direct type_identifier/qualified_type elements of the declaration's own interface_type) + 18 generic instantiations (GO2: not an interface embed) + 170 elements of a NESTED anonymous interface type − 2 sites that are BOTH (a generic element of a nested interface). The row-capable count is stated DIRECTLY, not by subtraction, because the two exclusion classes overlap. renders: the truth oracle derives 11 rows over the whole population and the arm has 11, EXACTLY (every published template execution was published as a row). decorates/part_of publish 0 rows and that is a RULING, not a blind spot: `decorates` is ONTOLOGICAL (an annotation is passive metadata; the callability test measures 0 struct-tag keys naming a declared callable) and `part_of` is GRAMMAR-ABSENCE (Go has no written construct whose target is a part file; `//go:embed` includes BYTES — 47 literal `.go` targets, all the sibling doc.go data-inclusion pattern, 0 source inclusions). Both rulings and their falsifiers live in script/m14/spec/go-completeness.json.
resolution_caveats.fixtures: the go fixture suite pins every construct this declaration counts, both directions: 34 pass / 0 fail (script/m14/run-fixtures.ts --lang go). The extended-vocabulary fixtures pin the embedding split (go/embedding-halves) and the renders construct (go/renders-template-execution, which forbids the impostor classes by name).
resolution_caveats.noRegex: resolution uses NO REGEX: the analyzer file carries 0 regex literals (the tree-sitter census attributes per lane), and the only reading surfaces are node types, fields, named children and stored rows.
